promptSpec.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready authored 2D side-scroller projectile sprite atlas, original fan-game art referenced to Metal Gear weapons, not a screenshot.
Create ONE landscape bitmap board at approximately1536x1024, exactly4columns by4rows (16cells total). Entire flat background pure magenta #FF00FF, thin straight cyan #00FFFF guides separating all equal rectangular cells. NO labels, text, numbers, icons, UI, logos, characters, vehicles, weapon mounts or scenery anywhere.
Camera: perfectly lateral orthographic side view. Every projectile points and travels RIGHT, with its trail to the LEFT. Center each complete isolated projectile horizontally and vertically in its own cell with at least35pixels of empty magenta on ALL sides. Nothing touches a guide, nothing spills into another cell. Uniform camera and object scale across each row. Four columns are FOUR DISTINCT authored consecutive in-flight animation phases, not4weapons, not reversed directions, not rotated views. Crisp detailed pixel-art edges and restrained highlights, readable against dark game backgrounds. All soft glow must end clearly before the magenta margin, no background gradients or shadows.
ROW1, all4cells: Sahelanthropus electromagnetic railgun discharge from MGSV. A compact elongated needle-white central streak enveloped by a short hot-orange pressure/plasma wake tapering LEFT, sharp luminous leading tip RIGHT. Four subtle fluctuating wake phases. White and orange ONLY, no blue electricity, no bullet cartridge, no round fireball, no emitter.
ROW2, all4cells: unmanned Metal Gear RAY from MGS2 Plant, high-pressure WATER CUTTER jet packet. Short horizontal dense white-blue stream of water, visible irregular fluid ribbons, foam, turbulent ripples and several tiny water droplets trailing LEFT. Rounded fluid leading edge RIGHT, clearly LIQUID WATER, NOT a laser, NOT electricity, NOT a missile. Four different turbulence phases at consistent size. Restrained blue-white palette with no pink and no neon electric branches.
ROW3, all4cells: Metal Gear D MG2 autocannon tracer. Small copper-gold pointed projectile dart heading RIGHT, a pale yellow hot core and a short muted amber tracer trail to the LEFT. Four small variations in tracer flicker, same physical bullet silhouette and scale. Projectile only; NO cartridge casing, no shell ejection, no missile fins, no launcher, no giant explosion.
ROW4, all4cells: Peace Walker Pupa shock-unit discharge. A short compact white-blue ELECTRICAL IMPULSE: narrow branching angular jagged arcs pointing RIGHT around a small bright leading knot; brief filament trail LEFT. Four distinct flickering arcs, stable envelope and scale. Clearly electric, never smooth laser or water, no magic orb, no mechanical launcher or paratonnerre object. Pupa is not equipped with Chrysalis's railgun.
The16source phases must all be completely drawn and individually extractable. No copied panels; maintain a modest central envelope, at most70percent cell width and35percent cell height. Make the four rows visually unmistakable: orange streak / water stream / copper tracer / branched electricity.
promptSpec.layout: 4x4; rows Sahel railgun / MGS2 RAY water cutter / MG2 D autocannon / Pupa shock

references.basis: Official Konami Pupa fight guide: electrical shock attacks, not Chrysalis railgun.
Scanned original MG2 manual, autocannon armament; projectile art is an original gameplay interpretation.
Secondary corroboration for conventional gun and missile weapons, not source pixels.
Secondary visual/canon corroboration of frontal electrical emitter.
MGS2 reference era; RAY water cutter, not the Rising plasma weapon.
Sahelanthropus era/design reference; bright railgun visual adapted to compact travelling projectile.

promptSpec.disclaimer: Original fan-made projectile bitmap interpretations, not official ripped assets or a guaranteed 1:1 simulation. Existing ballistic gameplay is unchanged.
